cards.title: The Engine Relay
cards.subtitle: Relay 9 of 12 — The Civilisational Relay
cards.body: Electricity rewired civilisation. From Tesla and Edison to the national grid — the engine relay electrified factories, homes, and communications. Power became invisible, ubiquitous, and transformative.
cards.alt_text: The Engine Relay — A large Tesla coil generates intense electrical arcs in the foreground, with power lines leading towards a massive hydroelectric dam in the distance.
cards.narration_text: The Engine Relay. Relay 9 of 12 — The Civilisational Relay. Electricity rewired civilisation. From Tesla and Edison to the national grid — the engine relay electrified factories, homes, and communications. Power became invisible, ubiquitous, and transformative.
cards.narration_voice_requirement: Neural warm measured slightly theatrical voice; do not use browser Web Speech for final release.
cards.david_prompt_seed: Where does The Engine Relay still govern daily life, and what would fail if it disappeared?
cards.player_action: Find a local example of The Engine Relay; show what it enabled and what resistance it overcame.

cards.content_action: Rebuild both body copy and central artwork around portable mechanical power and the nineteenth-century internal-combustion transition.
cards.replacement_body_or_instruction: Power broke free from the fixed steamworks. From early gas engines to the practical four-stroke cycle, the Engine Relay made motive force portable. Industry and transport could now move wherever fuel could reach.
cards.visual_issue: Artwork depicts Tesla/grid electrification rather than the canonical 1850 Engine Relay.
